This top-line momentum translates directly into superior profitability, highlighted by a quarterly operating margin of 40% in March 2026—a massive 28 percentage point expansion compared to 12% in the year-ago quarter [E25]. Furthermore, profit growth exceeding 1-year price growth by 80% signals that the company is beginning to outperform market expectations [E46], supported by screen reasons confirming both strong sales growth [E54] and profit growth exceeding 20% year-over-year [E56]. The company also boasts an impressive return on assets of 5.51%, standing in stark contrast to a negative sector benchmark of -171.35% [E7], and trades strongly at 86% of the way up its 52-week range [E4].
